fine_trace.note: The raw input bytes are reinterpreted as an array of 32-bit FriBidiChar codepoints; str_len=67. The input contains many LRE (0x202a) and RLE (0x202d) embedding controls plus an FSI (0x2068) isolate initiator.
Computes the bidirectional character type for each codepoint; the embedding/isolate controls become explicit/isolate types that drive the level stack.
Computes bracket types; none of the controls are brackets, so runs remain FRIBIDI_NO_BRACKET and are eligible for merging.
Entry point into the bidi algorithm where the run list is built and later compacted; this is where the crash occurs.
Encodes the bidi types into a doubly-linked list of FriBidiRun nodes, each with prev/next and prev_isolate/next_isolate links.
Each run is tagged with the current isolate_level as the explicit-levels phase walks the run list.

The many LRE/RLE/FSI controls push isolate_level up to the cap (FRIBIDI_BIDI_MAX_EXPLICIT_LEVEL-1 = 124). Once the cap is reached, further isolates no longer increment it, so runs that actually live at different isolate depths all get the same capped isolate_level of 124.

Builds the isolate tree by linking runs that share the same (capped) isolate_level. Because distinct isolate depths collapse to 124, runs that should be in separate isolate sequences are chained together, corrupting the prev_isolate/next_isolate links.

compact_list walks the run list and merges adjacent runs whose type, level, and bracket type match. Since the isolate_level check is absent here, runs at different true isolate depths (all capped to 124) are wrongly considered mergeable.

An adjacent pair of runs with equal type/level and no bracket is merged; merge_with_prev frees the second run and rewires the isolate links, but the isolate tree is already inconsistent from the collapsed isolate levels.
The second run is freed. Its prev_isolate/next_isolate links still point into the corrupted isolate tree, so a later merge dereferences a freed node.

Writes 8 bytes to next_isolate (offset 48) of a FriBidiRun that was already freed by an earlier merge_with_prev, because the collapsed isolate levels made prev_isolate point to a freed run. This is the heap-use-after-free WRITE 8 reported by ASAN.
